call_purpose: You had connected your payment gateway, but your customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they bought.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, then placed a test order and confirmed that the confirmation email arrived in your inbox.

covered.text: We found that the order confirmation email was switched off for your product.
We explained that the sender name can be changed under Email settings, Sender name.

customer_next_steps.text: Change the sender name to your brand name.
